result.Method of Attack: Runs highly obfuscated code that downloads a Windows Trojan executable; Info-stealer malware that accesses and alters Windows registry keys including security policies; Uses anti-detection and anti-reverse engineering techniques such as debugger presence checks
result.Attack Vector: Typosquatting Discord-related npm packages; Execution of obfuscated JavaScript code (index.js) upon package installation; Downloading and executing a malicious Windows executable from a suspicious URL
Indicators of Compromise: Domain 3psil0n[.]fr associated with multiple malware artifacts
